title: KIA-PDF Forces Ambush Resuming Junta Flotilla Between Shwegu and Bhamo, Sink Vessel, 100+ Surrender
detail: After being stalled in Shwegu since August 27 following an August 29 drone strike that disabled its lead warship, the junta's 15-vessel Ayeyarwady River resupply flotilla — which departed Mandalay's Gaw Wein jetty on August 21 — resumed its push toward Bhamo early on September 2, 2026. Kachin Independence Army (KIA) and allied People's Defence Force (PDF) units struck roughly eight vessels carrying troops, weapons and supplies along the Zinbon-Sinkhan stretch, sinking one of the largest armed vessels near Zinbon village and setting another ablaze near Sinkhan Bridge. Two vessels reportedly raised white flags and came ashore, with more than 100 soldiers, military family members, and officials surrendering to resistance forces; the KIA said its units also seized several vessels and took more than 100 prisoners of war during the fighting.

title: Karenni Resistance Forces Capture Junta Light Infantry Battalion 530 Position Near Loi Htwe, ~20 Soldiers Killed
detail: Karenni resistance forces captured a Myanmar military Light Infantry Battalion (LIB) 530 position east of Loi Htwe village near Loikaw, Kayah (Karenni) State on September 2, 2026, reportedly killing about 20 SAC soldiers in the assault. The gain added to a string of resistance advances in the Karenni theater and reportedly prompted a retaliatory junta airstrike wave on Shadaw Township three days later.
